propositions: Comment identity must be persisted as a local-comment-key (HLC timestamp) to Jira-comment-ID map in binding_store, replacing body-text equality dedup which collides on duplicate bodies and misses edits
Returned Jira comment IDs from add_comment must be captured at both creation and update enactment sites and recorded via write-ahead save() for crash-durability
Outbound and inbound comment identity are directionally authoritative: outbound uses the persistent map; inbound uses jira_comment_id field; neither direction competes or re-syncs mapped entries
Comment bodies must render through RichTextCodec.to_wire (AdfCodec for Cloud, WikiTextCodec for DC) with fit-before-serialize ordering; plaintext sanitization must not truncate serialized JSON
The _diff_comments dedup-key injection must migrate from _IdentityCodec to the real codec so normalized outbound keys match landed wire after rendering
Comment sync is append-only in both directions: new comments mirror once; edits and deletes are never pushed to Jira or applied from Jira
